_meta.purpose: Content pins for WISHMail reconnaissance of OpenConvAI (the HCS-10 standard and the `openconvai` registry key aggregated by the HOL registry broker).
_meta.method: Every repository `sha256` is computed over RAW GIT BLOB BYTES via `git cat-file blob <blobSha> | sha256sum`, never over the working-tree checkout. This machine runs core.autocrlf=true, so working-tree digests differ from object-store digests. blobSha is the git object id (`git rev-parse HEAD:<path>`). bytes is `git cat-file -s`.
_meta.onChainDigestMethod: Digests of on-chain content state their own recipe in a `recipe` field. HCS-1 content is reassembled by concatenating the `c` field of each message in sequence order, stripping the `data:application/json;base64,` prefix, base64-decoding, then brotli-decompressing. The topic memo carries `<sha256 of the decompressed bytes>:brotli:base64`.
_meta.readOnly: All repositories were pre-existing clones and were never modified. All HTTP was idempotent GET. No registration, purchase, write, or Hedera transaction was performed. POST /register/{uaid}/openconvai was deliberately NOT called; its schema is read from the published OpenAPI document.

profileContentLeg.why: Content-addressed by sha256 in the HCS-1 topic memo; recomputed and matched for both live agents. A past profile is re-obtainable and claims about it are falsifiable.

registrationBindingLeg.why: The register message has no signature field; in 420 of 420 observed messages the payer is an operator, not the claimed agent.

registryLabelLeg.why: The broker's registry=openconvai is not derivable from any on-chain byte; the ledger says registry=hol for the same agent.
